#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {}

    string next() {
        while (tokenizer.empty() || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            try {
                tokenizer = StringTokenizer(reader);
            } catch (exception& e) {
                throw runtime_error(e.what());
            }
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

private:
    class StringTokenizer {
    public:
        StringTokenizer(istream& stream) : stream(stream) {}

        bool hasMoreTokens() {
            return !stream.eof();
        }

        string nextToken() {
            string token;
            stream >> token;
            return token;
        }

    private:
        istream& stream;
    };

    istream& reader;
    StringTokenizer tokenizer;
};

class Util {
public:
    static void ASSERT(bool assertion) {
        if (!assertion)
            throw runtime_error("Assertion failed");
    }
};

class IntStack {
public:
    IntStack() : capacity(8) {}

    void push(int item) {
        if (size == capacity) {
            capacity <<= 1;
            array = new int[capacity];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
                array[i] = stack[i];
            delete[] stack;
            stack = array;
        }
        stack[size++] = item;
    }

    int size() const {
        return size;
    }

    int get(int i) const {
        Util::ASSERT(i < size);
        return stack[i];
    }

    string toString() const {
        int* trimmed = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i)
            trimmed[i] = stack[i];
        stringstream ss;
        ss << "[" << trimmed[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < size; ++i)
            ss << ", " << trimmed[i];
        ss << "]";
        delete[] trimmed;
        return ss.str();
    }

private:
    int* stack;
    int* array;
    int capacity;
    int size;
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        virtual ~Modulus() {}
        virtual long modulus() const = 0;

        long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.size() <= n) {
                factorial.push((int) mult(factorial.get(factorial.size() - 1), factorial.size()));
            }

            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = factorial.size() - 1;

            if (lastKnown < n) {
                long* fInv = new long[n - lastKnown];
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < fInv.size(); ++i) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                    invFactorial.push((int) fInv[i]);
                }
                delete[] fInv;
            }

            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long ncr(int n, int r) {
            ASSERT(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r)
                return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long normalize(long x) {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0)
                x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long add(long a, long b) {
            long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long subtract(long a, long b) {
            long v = a - b;
            return v < 0 ? v + modulus() : v;
        }

        long mult(long... x) {
            long r = 1;
            for (long i : x)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long mult(long a, long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long inv(long value) {
            long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            ASSERT(g == 1);
            ASSERT(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());

            return normalize(x);
        }

    protected:
        Modulus() : factorial(), invFactorial() {}

        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long modulus() const {
            return 998244353L;
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    istream& input = cin;
    ostream& output = cout;

    InputReader in(input);
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();

    mod.fInv(n + m);

    long phaseSize = 1;
    long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        long numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        long e = mod.mult(numPhases, phaseSize);
        long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), e);

        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
    }

    output << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}
